paper.title: A wireless terahertz cryogenic interconnect that minimizes heat-to-information transfer

evidence.text: The contribution is a 260-GHz wireless cryogenic interconnect using passive cold detection and backscatter. Its main experimental results concern the link and heat load. Amplifier design is not the primary contribution.
